text:
alex: Heads-up — quick sync on long-term routing/playbook for multi-region + multi-tenant isolation. Want to align on launch criteria and customer asks. TL;DR: I'm proposing three primary lanes: edge-affinity, regional-fallback, tenant-quarantine. Thoughts?

priya: +1 to lanes. Can we fold in a strict data-residency/compliance lane for EU-only customers? :european_union:

kevin: That will drive private deployment + KMS/HSM work. We should call that out explicitly as a separate "compliance lane" in contracts and deployment docs.

rachel: From product/customer asks: predictable latency guarantees, explicit fallback behaviors (documented order of operations), and soft-eviction semantics. We also need acceptance tests to prevent regressions.

alex: Early draft of launch criteria (short):
1) Regional failover adds <200ms tail latency for warm cache paths
2) Per-tenant isolation toggle (boolean) with resource bounding
3) Audited routing logs + telemetry retention 90d
Any objections or missing items?

priya: 200ms seems optimistic for cold starts. Recommend we split warm vs cold: <200ms warm, <1s cold. Also need to call out egress/legal constraints per region.

kevin: Agree on warm/cold split. Also: model-variant fallback policy — prefer a compatible quantized variant in-region before failing cross-region. That reduces egress and privacy exposure.

rachel: Product asks an explicit "promote-to-dedicated" path when tenant > threshold QPS. Need console hooks and an API to kick off migration.

alex: Action items from this thread: a) surface compliance lane + KMS reqs (priya) b) perf SLO proposal + sims (kevin + infra) c) console UX for tenant routing toggles and promote path (rachel) d) migration plan for existing tenants (alex).

devops-bot: deploy-bot: created draft doc at /docs/routing/affinity-playbook-draft — requesting reviews from @kevin @rachel.

priya: I'll draft the compliance lane addendum — ETA EOD Wed.

kevin: I'll run perf sims focused on egress patterns and kv-cache warmup. Quick sample config I'm testing locally: 
```yaml
routing_policy:
  type: regional_affinity
  fallback:
    cross_region: true
    prefer_quantized_variant: true
  max_extra_ms:
    warm: 200
    cold: 1000
```

rachel: We should pair that with acceptance checks: synthetic tail-latency tests, prompt-level quality evals on fallback variants, and billing/regression smoke tests. I'll populate a checklist.

alex: OK — reconvene Fri 10:00am PT to review artifacts. If anyone sees hard objections post here. :thumbsup:

kevin: noted. I'll post initial sim results by Thu afternoon.

priya: +1. Also adding a short risk table to the doc for compliance lane (latency, cost, audit burden).

rachel: I'll mock console toggles and add API surface by Thu.

alex: Thanks all. If helpful, I'll sketch an example migration sequence (canary -> staged cutover -> full promote) and drop it in the draft before Fri.

devops-bot: reminder: calendar invite sent for Fri 10:00am PT — channel thread updated.
